name: bluebird-forecast-api-types
description: Generates frontend/src/api-schema.d.ts from backend/openapi.json. A package of its own so Dependabot can see the generator, which a version inside an npm script is invisible to. It cannot join frontend/package.json: openapi-typescript loads the TypeScript compiler API at run time and peers on ^5.x, the app runs TypeScript 7, and npm resolves one version of a peer.
